mechanism: Alendronate may reduce CoQ10 absorption through effects on gastrointestinal pH and motility, and statins (often co-prescribed with bisphosphonates) deplete CoQ10 via HMG-CoA reductase inhibition.
action: Monitor for symptoms of CoQ10 deficiency (myalgia, fatigue); consider timing separation of doses and CoQ10 supplementation if clinically indicated.
